verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS invoicing product that holds customer and payment data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers AI training data use, opt-out controls, or a data-usage policy. The MCP server, CLI and llms.txt items concern AI tooling access, not training-data privacy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
